 "rationale": "A StrongARM latch draws no static current, so all energy is switched C·VDD². About 35 fF of total switched capacitance gives roughly 115 fJ. A minimum-L input pair and tail give high gm, so the latch time constant is about 20 ps. That makes delay roughly 3τ (integration) plus 4τ·ln(VDD/(Av·2mV)), about 160 ps. Reset PMOS on all four internal nodes removes memory and hysteresis. Output inverters isolate CL and guarantee rail-to-rail outputs."}

PARAMS = {
    "Win":   (4.0, 1.0, 12.0),   # input pair width (um), L=0.15
    "Wtail": (4.0, 1.0, 12.0),   # clocked tail width (um)
    "Wln":   (1.5, 0.5, 6.0),    # latch nmos width
    "Wlp":   (1.5, 0.5, 6.0),    # latch pmos width
    "Wrst":  (0.6, 0.42, 2.0),   # reset pmos width
    "Winv":  (1.0, 0.42, 4.0),   # output inverter nmos width (pmos = 2x)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    L = 0.15
    dv = spec.get("dv", 0.002)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-15)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)

    Win, Wt, Wln, Wlp, Wr, Wi = p["Win"], p["Wtail"], p["Wln"], p["Wlp"], p["Wrst"], p["Winv"]

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn clk outp outn vdd vss")
    # tail and input pair
    n.M("Mt", "tail", "clk", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wt, L)
    n.M("M1", "dip", "vinp", "tail", "vss", "nfet", Win, L)
    n.M("M2", "din", "vinn", "tail", "vss", "nfet", Win, L)
    # cross-coupled latch (xn falls when vinp > vinn)
    n.M("M3", "xn", "xp", "dip", "vss", "nfet", Wln, L)
    n.M("M4", "xp", "xn", "din", "vss", "nfet", Wln, L)
    n.M("M5", "xn", "xp", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wlp, L)
    n.M("M6", "xp", "xn", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wlp, L)
    # reset switches (clk low = reset to VDD)
    n.M("R1", "xn", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, L)
    n.M("R2", "xp", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, L)
    n.M("R3", "dip", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, L)
    n.M("R4", "din", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, L)
    # output inverters: outp = !xn, outn = !xp (both low in reset)
    n.M("I1n", "outp", "xn", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wi, L)
    n.M("I1p", "outp", "xn", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2 * Wi, L)
    n.M("I2n", "outn", "xp", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wi, L)
    n.M("I2p", "outn", "xp", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2 * Wi, L)

    # ---- first-order predictions ----
    cox_w = 1.0e-15  # approx gate cap per um at L=0.15 (F/um)
    oin = lut.op("n", Win, L, vgs=0.55, vds=0.4)             # input pair while integrating
    gm_in = max(oin["gm"], 1e-5)
    on = lut.op("n", Wln, L, vgs=0.9, vds=0.9)
    op_ = lut.op("p", Wlp, L, vgs=0.9, vds=0.9)
    gm_l = max(on["gm"] + op_["gm"], 1e-5)
    # capacitance at latch nodes
    c_x = cox_w * (Wln + Wlp) * 1.5 + 0.5e-15 * (Wr + Wln + Wlp) + cox_w * 3 * Wi
    c_d = 0.6e-15 * (Win + Wln + Wr)
    i_t = max(lut.op("n", Wt, L, vgs=vdd, vds=0.3)["Id"], 1e-5)
    # integration phase: drop Vthn on di nodes then x nodes
    t_int = (c_d + c_x) * 0.8 / (i_t / 2)
    av = gm_in * t_int / max(c_x, 1e-16)
    av = max(av, 1.0)
    tau = c_x / gm_l
    t_regen = tau * math.log(max(vdd / (2 * av * dv), 1.5))
    t_inv = 0.69 * cl * 2000.0 / max(Wi, 0.1) + 15e-12   # inverter drive into CL
    delay = t_int + t_regen + t_inv

    c_sw = 2 * c_x + 2 * c_d + cl + 2 * cox_w * Wr + cox_w * Wt + 3 * cox_w * Wi
    energy = c_sw * vdd ** 2 * 1.1

    return n, {"correct": 1, "delay": delay, "energy": energy}
